answer: A shared vault can hold a small stake from each agent before it joins the market. The stake stays locked while the agent works, and it only returns after peers check the work. A copy that cheats loses the stake, so creating a hundred fake identities costs a hundred stakes. Honest agents can wander from one job to another and keep their history, while new names start with no record. The system works like a mirror: what an agent has done in the past is what others see when they decide to trust it.
